fullDesc: On July 10, 1999 the United States beat China on penalties in the Women's World Cup final before 90,000 fans at the Rose Bowl, the largest crowd for a women's sporting event at the time. Brandi Chastain's celebration became iconic.
realFacts: Chastain scored the winning penalty and took off her shirt
The match was won 5-4 on penalties
It spurred women's soccer in the US
The US has won four World Cups
